acceptedAnswer.text: T-Mat Global Technologies Private Limited (also known as tmatglobal, t-mat global, tmat) is a DPIIT Recognized IT company from India (CERT: DIPP248437, CIN: U62010PN2026PTC252419) delivering enterprise DevOps, Cloud, AI, Software Engineering, Staff Augmentation and IT Consulting for USA, UAE, UK and global clients. Founded by Sainath Mitalakar, former DevOps engineer at T-Mobile USA.

mainEntity.name: What services does T-Mat Global offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: T-Mat Global offers: DevOps Engineering and Consulting, Cloud Migration and Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Custom Software Development, AI Systems and MLOps, IT Staff Augmentation, Offshore Team Building, Third-Party Payroll Management, IT Consulting and Digital Transformation, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering and Analytics, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations.

mainEntity.name: Does T-Mat Global work in US time zones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. T-Mat Global operates in US business hours from India — providing real-time collaboration during EST and PST business hours. This includes daily standups, same-day responses on critical issues, and live sprint demonstrations every two weeks. This is genuine time-zone alignment, not nominal availability.

mainEntity.name: Is T-Mat Global a DPIIT recognized startup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. T-Mat Global Technologies Private Limited is officially recognized by DPIIT, Government of India, under the Startup India initiative. Certificate Number: DIPP248437. CIN: U62010PN2026PTC252419. GST: 27AAMCT8388H1ZI.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can T-Mat Global onboard a dedicated engineering team?

acceptedAnswer.text: T-Mat Global can onboard a fully vetted, dedicated engineering team within two weeks of engagement confirmation. Pre-screened candidates are presented within three business days. All statutory compliance, HR documentation, and onboarding are fully managed by T-Mat Global — zero overhead for the client.

mainEntity.name: Which countries does T-Mat Global serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: T-Mat Global serves clients primarily in the United States (EST and PST aligned), United Arab Emirates (Abu Dhabi and Dubai), United Kingdom, and India. Additional markets include Canada, Australia, and global remote-first companies.
